title: Off-Diagonal Kappa-Oscillator Identification
body_html:
Off-Diagonal Kappa-Oscillator Identification

Let \({}^\boxminus\omega\) be the pullback of the finite oscillator representation on \(S({}^\boxminus b)\) through the off-diagonal stabilizer morphism. Then, as a module for \({}^\boxplus S\ltimes{}^\boxminus J_M\), \[ {}^\boxminus\kappa_M\simeq{}^\boxminus\omega. \]
proof_html: For \(h=(\exp X,\exp X')\in{}^\boxminus J_M\), the lattice-model phase satisfies \[ \frac12\langle w,h^{-1}w-w\rangle = B(X,\Gamma)+B(X',\Gamma') \] after passing to the quotient modulo the conductor. The off-diagonal block isomorphism supercuspidal_theta.off_diagonal_block_isomorphism identifies the off-diagonal Lie quotient with \({}^\boxminus b\) as a finite symplectic space. Under that identification, the special morphism used in Yu's \(\kappa\)-construction is the same morphism defining the pulled-back oscillator action.
